installer.installed.title: {app} is already installed
installer.installed.text: This version is already installed. Do you want to start the installed one?
installer.renamed.title: Update to {app} {version}?
installer.renamed.text:
Videosprog is now called {app}. Version {have} is installed. Do you want to update?
Your settings, word list and downloaded files are kept, and the shortcuts are moved.
installer.update.title: Update to version {version}?
installer.update.text:
Version {have} is installed. Do you want to update it to {version}?
Your settings, word list and downloaded files are kept.
installer.install.title: Install {app}?
installer.install.text:
The program goes into your own programs folder (no administrator needed), and you get a shortcut in Start and on the desktop.

Afterwards you can delete the folder you unzipped.
installer.connect_claude: Connect to Claude, so you can ask Claude to make videos
installer.app_open: {app} is open, so its files cannot be replaced. Close {app} (wait if it is working on a video), then press Try again.
installer.in_use: The program is in use. Close {app}, and quit Claude completely (right-click the Claude icon by the clock -> Quit). Then press Try again.
installer.copy_incomplete: The copy is incomplete ({name} is missing).
installer.progress.hint: This usually takes 10–30 seconds. The window cannot be closed while the program is being copied.
installer.line.start.head: INSERT COIN …
installer.line.copy.head: Be kind, rewind …
installer.line.copy.text: Copying the film reels onto your hard drive
installer.line.check.head: Splicing the footage …
installer.line.models.head: Shelving the voice tapes …
installer.line.models.text: Danish, Swedish, Norwegian and English, all in their cases
installer.line.shortcuts.head: Sticking on the VHS labels …
installer.line.shortcuts.text: You'll find them in Start and on the desktop
installer.line.claude.head: Calling Player 2 …
installer.line.cleanup.head: Taping over the old show …
installer.line.cleanup.text: Videosprog goes in the returns box
installer.line.final.head: Adjusting the tracking …
installer.line.final.text: The snow is clearing from the picture
installer.done.head: LEVEL UP! {version}
installer.done.title: Version {version} is installed
installer.restart.title: Restart Claude
installer.restart.text: Quit Claude completely (Quit in the menu) and open it again, so Claude uses the new version.
installer.fail.head:
GAME OVER?
No, CONTINUE!
installer.fail.unchanged: The installation did not finish. Nothing has changed in your old version.
installer.fail.stopped: The installation stopped unexpectedly. See log.txt in {folder}.
